summary.text: Jim Eschrich is the Republican candidate for the Kansas House of Representatives, District 17, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democratic incumbent Jo Ella Hoye.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he spent most of his business career self-employed as a market researcher.

paragraphs.text: Jim Eschrich graduated from Kenmore East High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Niagara University in 1979, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as a marketing consultant.
He ran in the 2018 Republican primary for District 17, losing to incumbent Tom Cox, 75.5 percent to 24.5 percent.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Eschrich said the district's suburban voters need representation focused on issues such as property taxes and data centers.
He named affordability as the biggest challenge and proposed capping property taxes, placing summary boxes on property tax statements, and auditing entitlement spending.
